context: Asuka lectures on history and cause.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: history lecture; connectives (そもそも/たとえば/それら/本来/もっとも) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そもそも、歴史はなぜ動くのでしょう。
lines.en: To begin with, why does history move?
lines.style: contemplative teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: たとえば、戦争が原因ですか?
lines.en: For example, is war a cause?
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: たとえば戦争も、それらの一つです。
lines.en: War, for example, is one of those.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: それらは、つながっているんですか?
lines.style: engaged teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、本来、原因は絡み合っています。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: もっとも、偶然もあるんですよね?
lines.en: That said, there's chance too, right?
lines.style: thoughtful teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: もっとも、偶然も歴史を動かします。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: それらを学ぶと、面白いですね。
lines.style: delighted teen boy voice, soft warm bright engaged throughout
